<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Org" name="Organisation" processRef="Process_1"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_1" isExecutable="false">
    <!-- Lanes -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_EC" name="EC">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EC_tells</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_INQ" name="INQ">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_INQ_notifies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_IP" name="IP">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IP_checks</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_check</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IP_confirms</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IP_rejects</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- Flow nodes -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_1" name="Process start"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EC_tells"
               name="EC tells INQ about the change of his master data"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_INQ_notifies"
               name="INQ notifies IP of the change"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IP_checks"
               name="IP checks whether the master data can be changed at the desired time"/>
    
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_check"
                           name="Can master data be changed?"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IP_confirms"
               name="IP confirms the changes of the INQ"/>
    
    <bpmn:task id="Task_IP_rejects"
               name="IP rejects the changes of the INQ"/>
    
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirm" name="Change confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Reject" name="Change rejected"/>

    <!-- Sequence flows -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_1" targetRef="Task_EC_tells"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_EC_tells" targetRef="Task_INQ_notifies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_INQ_notifies" targetRef="Task_IP_checks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_IP_checks" targetRef="Gateway_check"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5_yes" name="yes"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_check" targetRef="Task_IP_confirms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6_no" name="no"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_check" targetRef="Task_IP_rejects"/>
    
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_IP_confirms" targetRef="End_Confirm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_IP_rejects" targetRef="End_Reject"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

- If reject: task "IP rejects the changes of the INQ". then end event "Change rejected".
